name: Cleaning Force LLC
brandNarrative:
Cleaning Force LLC isn't just a cleaning company — it's the answer to the nagging feeling that your home deserves better. Based in Philadelphia, PA, they've built a reputation among type-A homeowners, busy professionals, and landlords who don't have time to settle for 'good enough.' Customers like Shannon Artis put it bluntly: 'BEST CLEANING COMPANY EVER' — and she's the kind of person who notices when something isn't right. When your toughest critics become your loudest fans, you're doing something right.

What separates Cleaning Force from the competition isn't just a mop and a checklist — it's the details no one asked for. During a move-out clean for Nateile Justice, the team went ahead and cleaned the basement without being asked, leaving the property so immaculate she walked away confident she'd get her full security deposit back. Joseph Bove booked them on less than 48 hours notice and watched them restore a stove and fridge to better-than-move-in condition. Zenia Pearson-Mixson had used another cleaning company for over a year before switching — and hasn't looked back since. That kind of loyalty isn't bought; it's earned one spotless room at a time.

Available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, Cleaning Force operates on the simple belief that a clean home shouldn't be a luxury or a logistical headache. Their online booking is fast, their communication is proactive, and their crews arrive on time and fully equipped. Whether it's a recurring home clean, a move-out deep clean, or a last-minute rescue job, they show up ready — and they leave every space smelling amazing.
ownerStory:
Cleaning Force LLC was built on a frustration most people share but few do anything about: the experience of hiring a cleaning service and still feeling like something was missed. The founders of Cleaning Force set out to build a company where attention to detail wasn't a selling point — it was the baseline. Operating out of Philadelphia's 19151 corridor, they created a team culture where going beyond the scope of work is the norm, not the exception. That ethos shows up in every review — in the basement that got cleaned without being asked, in the fridge that looked better than when a tenant first moved in, in the house that smells amazing every single time.

What the business has become is a reflection of that founding philosophy: reliable enough to book in under 48 hours, thorough enough to satisfy the most particular homeowners, and consistent enough that customers abandon their previous cleaning services to switch. With a 4.6-star rating across dozens of real customer experiences, Cleaning Force has earned its reputation not through marketing language, but through the kind of work that makes people pick up the phone and tell their friends.

reviews.text:
I recently hired Cleaning Force LLC for a move-out clean at my rental property, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the results. From start to finish, their service was exceptional.

The scheduling process was straightforward, and they were flexible in accommodating my timeline. The cleaning team arrived promptly and was professional and courteous throughout the entire process. They came fully prepared with all the necessary equipment and supplies.

What truly impressed me was their attention to detail. They tackled every area of the property, from the kitchen and bathrooms to the living spaces, and even the often-neglected corners. I was particularly pleased with how they handled the appliances, ensuring everything was left spotless. The carpets looked fresh and clean, and the floors shined like new.

An unexpected but delightful surprise was that they even took the initiative to clean the basement, which I hadn't specifically asked for. This extra effort showed their dedication to ensuring that the property was in perfect condition for the next tenants. It was clear they take pride in their work and want to leave no stone unturned.

The final walkthrough left me confident that I would receive my full security deposit back. Overall, I highly recommend Cleaning Force LLC for any move-out cleaning needs. Their professionalism, thoroughness, and commitment to customer satisfaction make them a standout choice. They truly made my move-out process much easier and stress-free!
reviews.author: Nateile Justice

reviews.text: During my last move I had to leave quickly and didn't have time to give the house a deep cleaning. I was able to book Cleaning Force on less than 48 hours notice, and their website made the booking process quick and simple. I was contacted quickly and maintained great communication leading up to the appointment. The cleaners arrived on time and ready to work and what a great job they did. They did a thorough cleaning of the house and even got the stove and fridge looking better than when I moved in. I am very grateful for Cleaning Force for the friendly, professional service they provided and would recommend them to everyone for their house cleaning needs.
reviews.author: Joseph Bove

faq.question: How quickly can you schedule a cleaning?
faq.answer: Cleaning Force can accommodate bookings with less than 48 hours notice. Their online booking system is fast and straightforward, and a team member will follow up quickly to confirm your appointment and maintain communication leading up to the clean.

faq.question: What makes Cleaning Force different from other cleaning companies?
faq.answer: Customers consistently highlight three things: attention to detail that goes beyond what's asked (including areas like basements that weren't even specified), punctual and fully-equipped crews, and results that leave homes looking and smelling noticeably better than before. Multiple customers have switched from other services and say they won't go back.

faq.question: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?
faq.answer: Yes. Cleaning Force offers a customer satisfaction guarantee, giving clients peace of mind that their space will be cleaned to a high standard. If something isn't right, they make it right.

faq.question: What does your move-out cleaning include?
faq.answer: Move-out cleans cover all rooms including kitchens, bathrooms, living spaces, appliances (inside and out), floors, carpets, and often areas like basements — even without being specifically asked. The goal is to leave the property in the best possible condition for the next occupant and help tenants recover their full security deposit.

faq.question: Do your cleaners bring their own supplies and equipment?
faq.answer: Yes. The Cleaning Force team arrives fully prepared with all necessary equipment and cleaning supplies. You don't need to provide anything — just access to your space.

faq.question: Are you available on weekends and after hours?
faq.answer: Yes. Cleaning Force is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays. Whether you need an early morning clean, an evening appointment, or an emergency same-day service, they're available to accommodate your schedule.

brandColors.note: Deep professional blue conveys trust, reliability, and the kind of systematic thoroughness customers rave about — grounded and dependable.
